name: keepplain
description: Send a Claude Code session to KeepPlain as a draft Build: the prompts, interventions and fails that mattered. You review and publish it on the site. Your agent can also look up how other developers did a similar task in the KeepPlain library, and /keepplain:use puts a published Build's playbook into your repository as a skill or a rule. /keepplain:share puts a published Build into its pull request: how the change was built, for the reviewer.
